name: CDC Interactive Atlas of Heart Disease and Stroke Mortality (2022–2024)
short_name: CDC heart disease and stroke deaths
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Division for Heart Disease and Stroke Prevention
source_release_id: CDC Interactive Atlas of Heart Disease and Stroke (2022-2024, mri7-5jtw and y5ii-knwc)

geography_rules.national: GeographicLevel 'Nation' with LocationID '0'; stored as reference geoid 'US', never drawn as a map feature.
geography_rules.state: GeographicLevel 'State' with LocationID zero-padded to 2 digits, joined exactly to TIGER/Line 2024 state GEOID. Territories without a 2024 TIGER state are staged as source_only (no_2024_boundary).
geography_rules.county: GeographicLevel 'County' with LocationID zero-padded to 5 digits, joined exactly to TIGER/Line 2024 county-equivalent GEOID. Connecticut's eight former counties (09001-09015) are staged as source_only (legacy_connecticut_county_code) and never crosswalked.

boundary.vintage: TIGER/Line 2024 states and county equivalents (Connecticut planning regions)

limitations: These are CDC's age-adjusted death rates for adults 35 and older, averaged over 2022–2024. They are not the share of people with the disease.
County rates are spatially smoothed by CDC, which borrows strength from neighbouring counties. State and national rates are not smoothed.
CDC publishes no confidence interval for these rates. Small differences between counties may not be meaningful.
Connecticut values are for its former counties and are not shown on the 2024 planning-region boundaries.

measures.label: Heart disease death rate, adults 35 and older (per 100,000, age-adjusted)
measures.denominator: 100,000 adults aged 35 and older, age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population.
measures.official_definition: Age-adjusted 3-year average heart disease mortality rate per 100,000 adults aged 35 and older (2022–2024) from the National Vital Statistics System via CDC's Interactive Atlas of Heart Disease and Stroke.
measures.interpretation: County rates are spatially smoothed by CDC, which borrows strength from neighbouring counties; state and national rates are not smoothed. These are death rates, not disease prevalence. CDC publishes no confidence interval.

measures.official_definition: Age-adjusted 3-year average stroke mortality rate per 100,000 adults aged 35 and older (2022–2024) from the National Vital Statistics System via CDC's Interactive Atlas of Heart Disease and Stroke.
measures.interpretation: County rates are spatially smoothed by CDC, which borrows strength from neighbouring counties; state and national rates are not smoothed. These are death rates, not disease prevalence. CDC publishes no confidence interval.
